title: Naturally Citrusy Croatian Green Beans Tagine
description: A citrusy and snappy Croatian dish featuring green beans, cooked in a traditional tajine clay vessel and flambeed for added flavor, suitable for those following a low FODMAP diet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tajine clay vessel over medium heat.
Add the green beans to the vessel and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the garlic-infused oil, salt, and black pepper to the vessel and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and clementine zest.
Flambe the mixture by carefully igniting the liquid with a match or lighter.
Remove the vessel from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
